versions.changelog: Merge sanitized Google Voice caller workflow into google-voice: optional TTS/local-audio injection and call recording via private GV_COOKIE_PATH, plus CDP live-call mode.
Add outbound call support via logged-in browser/CDP UI automation and call HAR notes; no cookies or HAR secrets included.
Clarify bidirectional text messaging support: receive/read/export SMS records and send texts with explicit approval.
Initial publish: Google Voice SMS thread listing/reading/export from messages URLs or itemId values, HAR-derived MCP tools, browser-CDP auth, and safety guidance.
